title: Harish Salve: Why Supreme Court is Unlikely to Void Article 370 Move
description: In an exclusive interview with Karan Thapar for The Wire, the leading lawyer says the Modi government's decision to change Jammu and Kashmir's constitutional status was in line with past precedents and that parliament was within its rights to act on behalf of the state assembly in demoting J&K to Union Territory status. But he said the Supreme Court could have acted faster in hearing complaints about the violation of rights. #KaranThapar #HarishSalve  Like our work?
